judgment.rationale: The report gives an approximate time to failure and a known-good startup baseline, but does not identify whether the problem is app-specific.
evidence: On Windows 11 25H2 and PowerToys 0.102.3101, the reported letter-plus-Space gesture stops functioning after about 30 minutes.
The module and runner remain visible in Task Manager; toggling the module did not recover it.
judgment.recommended_action: Check the same shortcut in a plain text editor immediately after startup and again when the symptom appears.

issue_context.summary: Quick Accent reportedly works initially, then stops showing the picker or replacing the character until the device restarts.
known_information: The reporter tried both install channels and supplied an attachment.
inferences: The processes being present does not establish that the keyboard input is still reaching the module.
issue_context.analysis: Check activation in the same editor before and after the time window, then compare the affected foreground app with Notepad to separate global input loss from an app-specific path.
initial_investigation: Read the report and timeline and checked for matching Quick Accent restart reports. No attachment inspection or runtime reproduction was performed.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report does not yet isolate the failure to input delivery, module activation, or picker handling.

actions.label: Check Quick Accent activation before and after the reported time window

prerequisites: Disposable Windows 11 25H2 profile with Quick Accent enabled and Space configured as an activation key.
steps: After signing in, use the same test letter plus Space in Notepad and record whether the picker opens and the character is replaced.
Continue ordinary use for about 30 minutes. Repeat the test in the foreground app and in Notepad without restarting PowerToys.
If the shortcut fails in both apps, record when it first failed and whether the runner and module are still present before toggling the module.
reproduce.expected_result: Quick Accent continues to show its picker and insert the selected character in enabled apps after ordinary use.
